notes: §1985:IX.1.3.4 GRL2.1 sets '02' for any READ when "the key value for the current key of reference is equal to the value of the same key in the next record within the current key of reference", '02' for a WRITE/REWRITE creating a duplicate alternate, '04' for a length outside the fixed file attributes, and '05' for an absent OPTIONAL file, created "If the open mode is I-O or extend". IndexedConnector.ReadRandom asks NextRecordDuplicatesKey for the look-ahead unless DialectBehavior.IndexedDuplicateKeyStatusSequentialOnly (2002+) is active, SelectSequentialRecord's look-ahead serves READ NEXT, Write/Rewrite answer 02, KeyedConnector.OpenCore answers 05 and creates the file for I-O/EXTEND only; 04 cannot arise for an indexed file because WRITE refuses an out-of-bounds record (44) and OPEN refuses a file of other bounds (39, docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-129). Probes at --std 85 (classes b,c,e): random READ by alternate key on a duplicate set 02, on a singleton 00, by prime key 00, READ NEXT after it 00/00, START+READ NEXT 02,02,00, WRITE dup alt 02, dup prime 22, REWRITE dup alt 02, missing key 23; OPEN EXTEND/I-O absent optional 05 then OPEN INPUT 00, OPEN INPUT absent 05 twice (not created), non-optional absent 35 then READ 47; same program at --std 2023 gives random READ 00 (edition arm); varying-bound WRITE 25/5 chars 44, reader of other bounds OPEN 39. The witness exercises random-READ 02, WRITE 02 and OPEN I-O 05.

next.reason: CHANGED: 00, 04, 05 and WRITE/REWRITE 02 keep their meaning (§2023:9.1.13.2 GR1, GR3, GR4; GR2 c "For a REWRITE or WRITE statement, the record just written created a duplicate key value for at least one alternate record key for which duplicates are allowed"). READ 02 narrows: 1985 sets 02 for any READ when "the key value for the current key of reference is equal to the value of the same key in the next record within the current key of reference" (§1985:IX.1.3.4), which covers a random READ by an alternate key with duplicates (it returns the first of the duplicates, §1985:IX.4.5.4 GR17); 2023 sets 02 only "For a READ statement with the NEXT phrase specified or implied" (§2023:9.1.13.2 GR2) and only when "an indexed file is being sequentially accessed, the key of reference is an alternate record key" (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR27), so that random READ now completes with 00. PREVIOUS and DELETE FILE 05 are 2023-only syntax.
